investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC investigation per BOTM-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01: one unauthenticated GET to the venue's official_website (WebFetch/curl fallback), with at most one additional same-origin GET when official_programme_url was directly supplied as a candidate field. No browser, authentication, CAPTCHA bypass, or retry loop.

venue_reference: Tramshed Theatre — Woolwich New Road 41, SE18 6ET, London

identity.notes: Canonical URL resolves to the same registrable domain as the supplied official_website (301 www->non-www redirect only); <title>, og:title, and og:site_name all read 'Tramshed'.

probe_history.reason: A single unauthenticated GET to the official homepage returned meta/og description text that directly and unambiguously self-describes the venue's core identity as a community arts hub, conclusively answering the music-relevance question without further escalation.

reasons: The venue's own meta/og description states: 'South-East London's home of participation. A community arts hub focusing on young people, learning disabled adults and local community members.' — the venue self-identifies as a community arts hub, not a music venue.

The retained keyword scan of the fetched body shows zero occurrences of 'live music', 'gig', 'band', 'jazz', 'cabaret', 'musical', or 'comedy', against 14 occurrences of 'community' and 5 of 'young people' — real evidence the primary programme is community participation work, failing BeatMapped's venue-level music gate.

evidence.description: Verbatim, byte-faithful <head> excerpt: <title>, canonical link, og/twitter tags, and meta description, self-describing the venue as a community arts hub.
evidence.method: curl -sS -L; descriptive User-Agent; single unauthenticated GET; redirects followed; no retry
